head: codex/5658-bound-worktree-lifecycle
title: [v0.91.8][csdlc-v2][tooling] Keep lifecycle writes in bound worktree
body:
Closes #5658

Keeps typed C-SDLC v2 bind lifecycle writes rooted in the declared issue worktree instead of advancing primary-main issue state during non-local bind. The bind path now materializes issue records, prepared artifacts, evidence roots, and locks into the registered target Git worktree before committing the bound transition there.

Hardening included the pre-PR review findings: unregistered target directories fail closed, symlinked lifecycle state is rejected, created-worktree failures are compensated, evidence is copied with issue state, and stale existing target lifecycle/prepared/evidence state fails closed before side-state mutation.

Focused validation:
- `cargo test --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --test gate7_lifecycle` passed locally on FastWork with 30 tests.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` passed.

Pre-PR review: bounded subagent review is clean at exact head `eb6d7dde9f5bdf8e916d4458874c79b532767e13`.
